## Explore My Projects

Welcome to my digital marketing and analytics portfolio.

This collection highlights selected academic and professional projects involving marketing analytics, website performance measurement, consumer research, and digital marketing strategy.

## How Quarto Listings Work

Quarto Listings automatically organizes documents from a designated folder and displays them in a structured format.

For this portfolio, I use a grid layout that makes it easy for visitors to explore individual projects.

## Benefits of Listings

- Automatically organizes project entries
- Provides consistent navigation
- Supports portfolio expansion
- Makes research and analytics projects easier to discover
- Improves the presentation of professional work
